about: What a person, a place or an object is known for: a few clauses, each with the verses that say it, in English, Ukrainian, German and Spanish, written by a language model and read twice more. Nothing here is shown on the site until it is approved: an entry answered 'approved' is loaded by the next load of the known-for step, one answered 'rejected' is not. 'declined' lists the records the first reading gave no line, with its reason.
source: Essenthos, what a record is known for, written from its verses in the King James Version with the verses each clause rests on by claude-sonnet-5-5 on 2026-10-25, read again clause by clause against those verses and rendered into Ukrainian, German and Spanish by a second, separate reading, the renderings read by a third; on the project owner's instruction, each record shown once he has approved it

clauses.deu: wurde von Aaron aus den goldenen Ohrringen des Volkes gemacht und als die Götter angebetet, die Israel aus Ägyptenland geführt haben
clauses.spa: fue hecho por Aarón con los zarcillos de oro del pueblo y adorado como los dioses que sacaron a Israel de la tierra de Egipto
clauses.renderingsChanged: Ukrainian verb made neuter to agree with «Лите теля»; German «Ohrenringen» modernized to «Ohrringen».

clauses.english: was burnt, ground to powder and scattered on the water by Moses, and the people made to drink it
clauses.ukr: було спалене Мойсеєм на вогні, змелене на порох, розсіяне по воді, і ним були напоєні сини Ізраїлеві
clauses.deu: wurde von Mose im Feuer verbrannt, zu Pulver zermalmt und aufs Wasser gestreut, und die Kinder Israels mussten es trinken
clauses.spa: fue quemado por Moisés en el fuego, molido hasta reducirlo a polvo y esparcido sobre las aguas, y los hijos de Israel tuvieron que beberlo
clauses.renderingsChanged: Ukrainian participles made neuter to agree with «Лите теля»; German «Kinder Israel» modernized to «Kinder Israels».

first.reason: The verses tell what was done with the calf and what happened through it: it was made from the people's gold and worshipped, and Moses destroyed it.
doubts: The first clause is slightly over 100 characters; it joins the making and the worship, which the verses present as one event.
